notes.title: Wishlist Tiny Dangerous Dungeons Remake!
notes.content:
Tiny Dangerous Dungeons is being completely rebuilt from scratch with brand new graphics, music, and content. Featuring new and improved dungeon that is twice the size than in the original game, with new secrets, new items, new enemies, and ferocious new boss battles!

Check out the trailer:

[previewyoutube=ExXVDGr9v9k;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3179810/Tiny_Dangerous_Dungeons_Remake/

notes.title: Ice Dungeon now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32987777/5298c1a39c050a67763c66996a4fffffc769f30c.gif[/img]

Hey folks! Super Dangerous Dungeons free ice dungeon update is now available! Slide your way through ice, snow and icicles in 11 new frosty levels! Check out the trailer: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9WtRSfqiDms

I've also added an option for rebinding controls in the settings menu. This means I've had to remove some previous default overlapping controls to make it work. The game now uses same default controls as Tiny Dangerous Dungeons (arrow keys for movement, X for jumping/selecting).

notes.title: Bugfixes and Mac support is here!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

I have finished the Mac version of the game and published it! Sorry for the wait.

I've also just updated the game with couple of small bugfixes:
- Holding both right and left movement while landing doesn't make you slide across the ground in falling animation anymore.
- Grass dungeon time trial was saving times to the leaderboard as way higher than they actually were (5 min run would be reported as like 5 hours).

You can view Steam leaderboards here: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/856540/leaderboards/2689034/
If your time appears as crazy high, running the trial again and beating your previous in-game record should submit a correct time now.
